notes.title: Multiplayer Open World RPG - DevLog 10!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=MxcMiunLALg;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]       










Sovereign will feature co-op multiplayer!
With this, came a whole revamp of the world, since it was originally done with just single-player in mind.

Looting, questing, combat and more fun experiences can be shared with friends!

The art-style now will be a bit more detailed! As seen in the devlog!

The devlog also features the start of the development of Neverfall, a city in Sovereign that has a beautiful castle.
